headline: Maresca replaces Guardiola at Man City as Rodri reports clash
paragraphs: Manchester City have moved on from Pep Guardiola. Sky Sports posted highlights of Enzo Maresca's first news conference as City's new manager on Friday, and a separate Sky in Italy report has Guardiola turning down the vacant Italy head coach job, with Andrea Pirlo closing in on that role instead. Both items come from Sky's own properties rather than independent outlets, so the managerial change is Sky's reporting rather than something confirmed elsewhere in today's feed.

Real Madrid's interest in Rodri is inconsistent across the feed: a Sky live-blog headline on Friday said Madrid are working on a deal for the Manchester City midfielder, which conflicts with an earlier Sky report from 18 July describing Madrid as having cooled on him. Separately, BBC's Friday gossip column reported Real Madrid as open to selling Aurelien Tchouameni to Manchester United, with Arsenal linked in the same digest to John Stones and Ezri Konsa — all attributed rumour, none confirmed.

Liverpool's news split between the pitch and the boardroom. BBC's Thursday gossip column said Liverpool are confident of signing Bradley Barcola, a player they were earlier reported to have made contact with Paris Saint-Germain over — still unconfirmed. On ownership, Sky reported Fenway Sports Group in talks with a consortium fronted by Amit Bhatia, with Jeff Bezos mentioned, over a minority stake sale; that report is sourced only to Sky's own outlets.
